seed_selection: This regression case deliberately reuses the staircase-v1 and staircase-v2 seeds 1 through 10, in their original order and including reference seed 6, so policy hierarchical-task-progression-v1 can be compared with the accepted milestone and traversal-policy trajectories. staircase-v2 stays pinned to its own policy; this suite id exists because a new policy requires a new suite.
step_cap_rationale: The 1000-step cap and the acceptance of at least six successes including seed 6 are reused unchanged from staircase-v1 and staircase-v2. They were fixed before any staircase-v3 episode ran.
